items.name: Aerith Gainsborough
items.summary: A flower seller from the Sector 5 slums, and the last of the Cetra.

items.name: Barret Wallace
items.summary: The leader of AVALANCHE, fighting Shinra to save the planet.

items.name: Bombing of Mako Reactor 1
items.summary: AVALANCHE's attack on Shinra's Mako Reactor 1 in Midgar, the opening mission of the story.

items.name: Cloud Strife
items.summary: A swordsman from Nibelheim who says he was once in SOLDIER, and the story's protagonist.

items.name: Cloud's Memories Restored
items.summary: In the Lifestream, Cloud recovers his true memories of the past five years.

items.name: Death of Aerith
items.summary: Sephiroth kills Aerith as she prays at the altar in the Forgotten Capital.

items.name: Fall of the Sector 7 Plate
items.summary: Shinra brings the upper plate of Sector 7 down onto the slums beneath it.

items.name: Forgotten Capital
items.summary: A city of the Cetra in the far north, where Aerith goes to pray.

items.name: Midgar
items.summary: Shinra's city, divided into sectors and powered by mako reactors, with slums beneath its upper plate.

items.name: Nibelheim
items.summary: A mountain village with a Shinra reactor, and the hometown of Cloud and Tifa.

items.name: Nibelheim Incident
items.summary: Five years before the story, Sephiroth burns Cloud and Tifa's hometown during a Shinra mission to its Mako reactor.

items.name: Sector 7
items.summary: A sector of Midgar, home to the Seventh Heaven bar in the slums beneath its plate.

items.name: Sephiroth
items.summary: A legendary SOLDIER, believed dead, whom the party pursues across the world.

items.name: Tifa Lockhart
items.summary: Cloud's childhood friend from Nibelheim, who runs the Seventh Heaven bar in Sector 7.
